name: @loom/a2ui-callfunction
description: A2UI bidirectional RPC (callFunction) with @loom/plugin-a2ui — drives a client-side function from a Loom flow two ways: a read via a suspend/resume gate (grain A) and a side-effecting call via a delegated effect (grain B), the latter proving a crash mid-call parks at EFFECT_INDOUBT for an operator verdict rather than blindly re-firing. Headless, offline.
